016/**
017 * Central coordinator for game state, room navigation, and command handling.
018 *
019 * <p>Responsibilities include building the world graph, maintaining the current room and a stack
020 * for the {@code back} command, delegating user input to the {@link Parser}, and driving output
021 * through the {@link UserInterface}.
022 *
023 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
024 * @version 2026.02.17
025 */
026public class GameEngine {
027    /** User-facing output and optional room imagery. */
028    private UserInterface aGui;
029
030    /** Player state: current room, history, and inventory. */
031    private Player aPlayer;
032
033    /** Flag indicating whether the game is in test mode. */
034    private boolean aIsTest;
035
036    /** Trainers that may move after player navigation. */
037    private ArrayList<MovingTrainer> aMovingTrainers;
038
039    /** Lookup table from room id to room object for save/load operations. */
040    private java.util.HashMap<String, Room> aRooms;
041
042    /** Manager responsible for trainer battles and turn flow. */
043    private BattleManager aBattleManager;
044
045    /** Background music player for exploration and battle sessions. */
046    private MusicPlayer aMusicPlayer;
047
048    /**
049     * Builds the default map and creates the command parser.
050     *
051     * <p>The GUI is not set here; call {@link #setGUI(UserInterface)} after the interface exists so
052     * welcome text and images can be shown.
053     */
054    public GameEngine() {
055        this.createRooms();
056    } // GameEngine()
057
058    /**
059     * Attaches the user interface used for all player feedback.
060     *
061     * @param pUserInterface the Swing UI bound to this engine; must not be {@code null} for normal
062     *     play
063     */
064    public void setGUI(final UserInterface pUserInterface) {
065        this.aGui = pUserInterface;
066        this.aBattleManager = new BattleManager(this, pUserInterface);
067        this.aMusicPlayer = new MusicPlayer("Images/Audio.mp3");
068        this.aMusicPlayer.playLoop();
069        this.printWelcome();
070        this.losingTimer();
071    } // setGUI()

244    /**
245     * Disables input, pauses briefly, then exits the JVM.
246     *
247     * <p>The sleeps are used to give the player time to read the final messages.
248     */
249    public void endGame() {
250        try {
251            Thread.sleep(1000);
252        } catch (InterruptedException ignore) { // endGame()
253        }
254        this.aGui.enable(false);
255        try {
256            Thread.sleep(2000);
257        } catch (InterruptedException ignore) {
258        }
259        System.exit(0);
260    } // endGame()

262    /**
263     * Prints the welcome banner, initial location text, and the starting room image when one is
264     * configured.
265     */
266    public void printWelcome() {
267        this.aGui.println("Hello " + this.aPlayer.getName() + "!");
268        this.aGui.println("You can change your name with the command: name <new name>.");
269        this.aGui.println("Welcome to the world of Pokémon!");
270        this.aGui.println("A wonderful world where you can live an adventure!");
271        this.aGui.println("Type 'help' if you need help.");
272        this.printLocationInfo();
273        if (this.aPlayer.getCurrentRoom().getImageName() != null) {
274            this.aGui.showImage(this.aPlayer.getCurrentRoom().getImageName());
275    }
276        if (this.aPlayer.getItem("map") == null) {
277            this.aGui.showMap("no map.jpeg");
278        }
279    } // printWelcome()
280
281    /** Prints the long description of the current room (including exits and items). */
282    private void printLocationInfo() {
283        this.aGui.print(this.aPlayer.getCurrentRoom().getLongDescription());
284    } // printLocationInfo()

286    /**
287     * Decreases the progress bar over time and ends the game when it reaches 0.
288     *
289     * <p>This method runs on the calling thread and sleeps one second between updates.
290     */
291    private void losingTimer() {
292        for (int vI = 100; vI >= 0; vI -= 1) {
293            try {
294                Thread.sleep(10000);
295            } catch (InterruptedException ignore) {
296            }
297            this.aGui.setProgress(this.aGui.getProgressBar() - 1);
298            if (this.aPlayer.hasWon()) {
299                this.aGui.setProgressString("You won!");
300                return;
301            }
302        }
303        this.aGui.setProgressString("You lost..");
304        this.aGui.println("Time's up! You lose!");
305        this.aGui.showImage("lose screen.png");
306        this.endGame();
307    } // losingTimer()
